name: wts-web
description: Wood Talk Search frontend: Vite + Preact, served by the Worker as static assets

scripts.e2e:smoke: npm run build && npm run e2e:smoke:db && E2E_SMOKE=1 playwright test --project smoke
scripts.e2e:smoke:db: cd ../worker && rm -rf .wrangler/e2e-state && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env e2e --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --env e2e --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --file ../web/e2e/seed.sql
